scope: Authoritative harness state and supported repair surface for the immutable Milestone 1 pilot

durable_profile_semantics.profileServerBindingFromJson: includes serverId and harness in the parsed server binding
durable_profile_semantics.serializeSandProfileFile: persists binding.serverId and binding.harness into profile.json
durable_profile_semantics.projection_explanation: Coordinator Rb.noteRoster maintains an in-memory harness map, but that projection alone cannot account for the durable profile.json write and mtime.

restoreTemporalAgentRouting.effect: re-applies Temporal IDs to the coordinator in-memory routing projection

createAgent.effect: creates a new agent with a new immutable ID; this is not a same-ID repair

provider_identity_rpc.create_existing_agent_id_contract: agent_id is the create idempotency key; a retry returns the existing agent and a tombstoned id is never revived

provider_identity_sync.authority: remote GrokBotAgent row is synced down to profile.json with serverId+harness binding

GetGrokBotHarnessMigrationStatusInternal.comment: operator read surface for BOX -> Temporal rollout eligibility, hold, live-agent harnesses and pass history

ClearGrokBotHarnessMigrationHoldInternal.effect: drops an owner migration hold so BOX-bound commands stop being refused; an in-flight pass defers on hold_lost

EnsureGrokBotBoxHarnessMigrationPass.effect: starts/finds a rollout pass and returns DISABLED/DONE/PENDING

internal_primary_bot_migration.purpose: batch Primary/System Bot migration, not per-agent harness reversal

admin_surfaces.AdminGetGrokBotAgentDefinition: read-only identity/definition inspection; identity includes harness
admin_surfaces.sandbox_recreate_restore_surfaces: computer/store lifecycle only; not agent harness mutation

public_official_surface.cursor_docs: public Grok Bot docs document Bot creation, ordinary profile edit, duplicate, hide and delete; no same-ID harness conversion flow is documented
public_official_surface.unofficial_reconstruction_excluded: AkiKurisu/grok-bot is an unofficial older reconstruction and is not used as authority for current 0.57 lifecycle semantics

repair_conclusion.reason: M1 source admission requires the allowlisted immutable pilot to be BOX. Current durable profile, official roster, provider identity row semantics, coordinator RPC bridge, provider UpdateGrokBotAgent schema, internal BOX-to-Temporal migration surfaces and admin/recovery surfaces expose no supported reverse same-ID Temporal-to-BOX conversion.
repair_conclusion.only_scope_decision_to_continue: Allow creation of a new BOX pilot with a new immutable agent ID
